uddhaṃsota.cp: adj. going upwards in the stream of life.
uddhaṃsota.p: [Uddhaṃ+sota] (pu) CL=7 Flowing upstream. Uddhaṃsota(ti) [(1)uddhaṃ+vāhī+sota.(2)uddhaṃ+gantvā+paṭilabhitabba+sota] It has a flow to stream. (A) It has the flow of craving and the flow of suffering cyclic that can bring the upper Suddhāvāsa realm. (It will be rebirth-linking again in the upper Suddhāvāsa realm after he is dead in the Suddhāvāsa realm due to the flow of carving that is attached to the body and the flow of suffering cyclic that is not cessation). (B) If you go and reach the upper Suddhāvāsa realm, will get the flow of Arahattamagga, (If you reach the first Suddhāvāsa realm, you will not get Arahattamagga yet, after you die in that realm, you will reach the upper Suddhāvāsa realm, at this life you will attain  Arahattamagga and become Arahant and attain Nibbāna (cessation of strife)). uddhamāghātanika.p: [Uddhamāghātana+ika] (ti) CL=7 One who takes Uddhamāghātana doctrine that speaks of the body as a continuous living being after death, and the body that is continuous and not changing for the worse after death.
